description: This satellite image shows non-irrigated agricultural fields in Northern Germany, captured on 2012-07-27 by a Spot 5 sensor at 2.5 m resolution, using a 1/2/3 band combination (false-colour infrared). The landscape is structured by rectangular fields displaying a heterogeneous pattern of different colours and textures, indicative of a mix of diverse crops. Red hues indicate vital green vegetation, while bluish-green and brownish-grey areas represent other land cover types or less vigorous vegetation. Several four-digit land cover classification codes are overlaid on the fields in yellow text: "2330" (on two separate fields), "3110" (partially obscured), "5110", "2110" (on two separate fields), "1110" (partially obscured), and "1210" (partially obscured).
